body:
Hi @longnguyen2004 
Thanks for posting this issue.
Could you please help confirm which triplet you used to install and on which platform? Please also make sure if you have installed the related  components in Visual Studio.

I'm using the `x64-mingw` community triplet on Windows. I have Visual Studio installed, but I only use it for bootstrapping vcpkg, since I'm trying to use vcpkg with the [llvm-mingw](https://github.com/mstorsjo/llvm-mingw) toolchain.

Which port do you install? 
BTW, those triplets in community folder are currently not guaranteed to be built successfully.

Every port I try results in the same error
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/15729831/85412639-00b6f900-b594-11ea-8127-31c08d512f51.png)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/15729831/85412667-0a406100-b594-11ea-9df8-122e4ad6fcea.png)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/15729831/85412708-14faf600-b594-11ea-9d38-0205beb00b49.png)
If I had to guess, it's due to [/toolsrc/src/vcpkg/build.cpp](../blob/master/toolsrc/src/vcpkg/build.cpp) and [/script/buildsystems/vcpkg.cmake](../blob/master/script/buildsystems/vcpkg.cmake) missing the required `mingw` toolchain entry. I've tried [patching `build.cpp`](https://pastebin.com/DeTn8bCX) and so far I haven't had any problems. But I feel like this is not the correct way to do it

I think I see where the problem is. In [2020.01](https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/blob/2020.01/toolsrc/src/vcpkg/build.cpp#L504), if `CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME` isn't recognized, it does nothing. In [master](https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/blob/master/toolsrc/src/vcpkg/build.cpp#L542), it errors out, so the changes need to be reverted.
@longnguyen2004  Try https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/pull/12084. `vcpkg --triplet x64-mingw install zlib` worked fine for me with master.

issue.body:
**Describe the pull request**

This PR will allow building vcpkg itself with MinGW GCC 9.2.0. It fixes some warnings and because warnings are treated as errors, the build would fail.

It also fixes the usage of MinGW community tripplets.

Fixes: #12065

body:
@cristianadam you mentioned the wrong person :) anyway I'll try it now
btw #12084 is exactly what I did to fix the problem, but imo it's a bit unnecessary since [`vcpkg_configure_cmake` already loaded `mingw.cmake`](https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/blob/master/scripts/cmake/vcpkg_configure_cmake.cmake#L209) for us. The real fix here is to remove the error when the triplet isn't official, since I just found out that `*-ios` is also broken.

I've updated the previous comment. Sorry about that.

I used the fix you provided for build.cpp in order not to get the *Unable to determine toolchain* error. Then the `file(TO_CMAKE_PATH)` fixes the error that I got building zlib with MinGW, since it took the `c:\` part of the path and then CMake would bail with invalid `\P` characters.

 #12084 allows me to build vcpkg and install packages via `--triplet x64-mingw`.
